The second term must appear immediately after the first, not merely somewhere in the same document.
Separate fields or insert position gaps so a phrase cannot jump across title, body, array elements, or other semantic boundaries.
When one cursor is far behind, jump to a later known ID that still cannot pass the opposing candidate.
